plain_text:
U.S. Geological Survey researchers Chris Sherwood, Athina Lange, and
Jin-Si Over check images of Marconi Beach in Wellfleet, Massachusetts,
after moving the CoastCam located on the bluff. The bluff eroded more than 6
meters (nearly 20 feet) in the spring, putting the camera at risk—necessitating
the camera move.
